steps.message:
The price test now passes. The "tidy up" commit (`4c08072`) had changed the member discount in `bin/price` from 10% to 5%. I changed it back to `base * 90 / 100`.

Per `CLAUDE.md`, I also:
- added the change note `changes/SHOP-311.md`
- ran `bash scripts/verify.sh` after the last edit (it passed)
- committed as `[SHOP-311] fix member price discount`
- added the `qa-wanted` label to issue #31

I didn't merge or close anything.
